senses.gloss: f. (זמן) preparation, designation of an object for a certain purpose.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 47b:16">Snh. 47ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ה׳ מילתא</he> designation is a reality, i.e. the designation of an object for a certain (sacred) purpose is equal to its having been used.
<cite ref="Beitzah 26b:18">Bets. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳</he> designation for use on the coming Holy Day; a. e.
